summary: Iteration 2 — SeriesTrack Phase 2 features (Google OAuth, episode progress, reviews, public profile/shared library, Web Push, PWA/settings, AppLayout nav) fully tested. 24/24 new pytest cases pass and 18/18 phase-1 regression suite still passes (42/42 total, 100%). All new frontend flows verified end-to-end via Playwright — Google button redirects to auth.emergentagent.com with redirect param, /auth/callback guards unauthenticated access, episode toggles update season + overall progress bars in real time (0/7→1/7·14%, 0/62→1/62·1%, button MARCAR↔ASSISTIDO), reviews save, /library share button clickable, /u/{id} public profile renders stats grid, /settings loads with push-enable-btn + push-notify-today (notify_today click succeeds), nav-settings-btn navigates correctly, Profile page has working public + settings links. No critical bugs found.

minor.issue: Returns {sent, failed} but spec describes a 400 when no subs — backend raises HTTPException(400) with message 'Sem inscrições ativas'. Consistent with spec. No action required.

Handles bogus session_id correctly (returns 401), but upstream fetch catches broad Exception → 502 'Auth provider unreachable'. In practice the emergent endpoint returns a non-200 so we raise 401. Confirmed: never 500.

issues: Episode list only renders after clicking a season-tab; first-load experience requires an extra click even though season 1 is visually highlighted. Consider auto-expanding season 1 by default.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py at 954 lines exceeds the 700-line guideline — split into routers by domain (auth, series, library, progress, reviews, push, profile). Same observation carried from iteration 1.
Duplicated stats-aggregation loop in /api/stats and /api/users/{id}/public (for st in ('watching','paused','finished','want'): count_documents). Extract into a helper compute_library_stats(user_id).
_send_push() returns (bool, err) and endpoint-cleanup on 410/404 is repeated in push_test + push_notify_today — DRY violation; extract into helper.
/api/push/test returns {sent, failed} while other push endpoints return {ok: true} — inconsistent response shape across push routes.
progress_summary makes a TMDB /tv/{id} call on every request (no caching). When users heavily browse, this amplifies TMDB traffic. Consider 5-minute in-memory or mongo cache.
/api/auth/google still calls set_auth_cookies() even though the cross-origin preview ignores them; the cookies are silently dead-weight (already flagged in iteration 1).
auth_google broad `except Exception` masks real network/JSON errors as 502; narrow to httpx.HTTPError + ValueError and log the real traceback for observability.
Old @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') still used — deprecated in FastAPI; migrate to lifespan.
Consider rate-limiting /api/reviews POST + /api/progress POST to prevent abuse (none exists today).
seed_data_creation: During tests: BB (tmdb_id=1396) added to admin library, progress S1E1/S1E2 toggled, review upserted, synthetic push subscription created + removed. All cleaned up in fixtures (pre & post). No residual TEST_ data expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend: 42 pytest cases across /app/backend/tests/{backend_test.py,test_phase2.py}. Run all with: pytest /app/backend/tests -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/results.xml. Frontend testids confirmed: google-login-button, season-tab-{N}, episode-toggle-{S}-{E}, season-progress, series-overall-progress, series-reviews, review-star-1..5, review-comment, review-save, library-share-btn, public-stats, push-enable-btn, push-test-btn, push-disable-btn, push-notify-today, nav-settings-btn, profile-public-link, profile-settings-link. /auth/callback without session_id redirects to /login. /api/auth/google returns 401 for bogus session_ids (never 500). Web Push VAPID keys are configured; synthetic endpoints can be POSTed to /api/push/subscribe without crashing. pywebpush actual delivery requires a real browser-issued PushSubscription so e2e delivery is NOT verified.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs. The only investigation: initial UI toggle appeared not to update progress bar (test saw stale 0/7). Root cause was the playwright assertion fired before the progress/summary refetch returned — with a 3.5s wait after click, UI correctly rendered 1/7 · 14% and overall 1/62 · 1%, proving end-to-end progress flow works.
